import Mathlib

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: if 7 divides 2^n - 1, then 3 divides n
    intro h
    have h₁ : ∀ k : ℕ, 7 ∣ 2 ^ (3 * k) - 1 := by
      intro k
      rw [pow_mul]
      norm_num
      exact dvd_pow_self 7 (by omega)
    -- Use the fact that 2^n ≡ 1 (mod 7) iff n ≡ 0 (mod 3)
    have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
      have h₃ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
        have h₄ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := h
        have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
          omega
        exact h₅
      -- Check all possible remainders mod 3
      have h₆ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₆ with (h₆ | h₆ | h₆)
      · exact h₆
      · -- Case n ≡ 1 (mod 3)
        have h₇ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by
          have h₈ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 1 := by
            use n / 3
            omega
          rcases h₈ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod]
          <;> norm_num <;> omega
        omega
      · -- Case n ≡ 2 (mod 3)
        have h₇ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
          have h₈ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 2 := by
            use n / 3
            omega
          rcases h₈ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod]
          <;> norm_num <;> omega
        omega
    omega
  · -- Backward direction: if 3 divides n, then 7 divides 2^n - 1
    intro h
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [pow_mul]
    norm_num
    exact dvd_pow_self 7 (by omega)

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h
  have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 6 := by
    have h₂ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := h
    have h₃ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 6 := by
      omega
    exact h₃
  -- Check all possible remainders of 2^n mod 7
  have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases h₂ with (h₂ | h₂ | h₂)
  · -- Case n ≡ 0 (mod 3)
    have h₃ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₄ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k := by
        use n / 3
        omega
      rcases h₄ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
      simp [pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod]
      <;> norm_num <;> omega
    omega
  · -- Case n ≡ 1 (mod 3)
    have h₃ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by
      have h₄ : ∃ k, n = 3 * k + 1 := by
        use n / 3
        omega
      rcases h₄ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
      simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod]
      <;> norm_num <;> omega
    omega
  · -- Case n ≡ 2 (mod 3)

        omega

import Mathlib

open Nat

/-- Helper: `2 ^ (n + 3) % 7 = 2 ^ n % 7`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_cycle (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ (n + 3)) % 7 = (2 ^ n) % 7 := by
  have h23 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  calc
    (2 ^ (n + 3)) % 7
        = ((2 ^ n) * (2 ^ 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.pow_add] 
    _ = ((2 ^ n) % 7 * (2 ^ 3) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod]
    _ = ((2 ^ n) % 7 * 1) % 7 := by
          simpa [h23]
    _ = (2 ^ n) % 7 := by simp

/-- Main theorem (a). -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- rewrite divisibility as a congruence modulo 7
  have h_mod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] ↔ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.ModEq, Nat.ModEq_iff_dvd] using Iff.rfl
  constructor
  · intro h7
    -- from divisibility obtain a congruence
    have hcong : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq_iff_dvd).mpr h7
    -- write n = 3 * q + r with r = n % 3
    set q := n / 3 with hq
    set r := n % 3 with hr
    have hnr : n = 3 * q + r := by
      have := Nat.mod_add_div n 3
      simpa [hq, hr, Nat.mul_comm] using this
    -- compute the remainder of 2^n modulo 7 using the decomposition
    have hpow :
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ r) % 7 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7
            = (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) % 7 := by simpa [hnr]
        _ = (2 ^ (3 * q) * 2 ^ r) % 7 := by
            simpa [Nat.pow_add]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ q * 2 ^ r) % 7 := by
            simpa [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) % 7 * (2 ^ r) % 7) % 7 := by
            simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod]
        _ = (1 * (2 ^ r) % 7) % 7 := by
            have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
            simpa [this]
        _ = (2 ^ r) % 7 := by simp
    -- from the congruence we know the left side equals 1
    have : (2 ^ r) % 7 = 1 := by
      have := congrArg (fun x => x % 7) hcong
      simpa [hpow] using this
    -- now check the three possible values of r
    have hcases : r = 0 ∨ r = 1 ∨ r = 2 := by
      have : r < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases r <;> tauto
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · -- r = 0
      left
      have : n % 3 = 0 := by simpa [hr, h0]
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero this
    · -- r = 1 leads to contradiction
      have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 2 := by norm_num
      have : (2 ^ r) % 7 = 2 := by simpa [h1] using this
      have : (2 ^ r) % 7 = 1 := by simpa [this] using ‹(2 ^ r) % 7 = 1›
      exact (Nat.ne_of_lt (by decide)).elim (by simpa using this)
    · -- r = 2 leads to contradiction
      have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 4 := by norm_num
      have : (2 ^ r) % 7 = 4 := by simpa [h2] using this
      have : (2 ^ r) % 7 = 1 := by simpa [this] using ‹(2 ^ r) % 7 = 1›
      exact (Nat.ne_of_lt (by decide)).elim (by simpa using this)
  · intro h3
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_mul_left_mod (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by decide)) h3 with ⟨k, hk⟩
    -- n = 3 * k
    have hn3 : n = 3 * k := hk
    -- compute 2^n modulo 7
    have hpow : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ (3 * k)) % 7 = ((2 ^ 3) ^ k) % 7 := by
        simpa [Nat.pow_mul] using rfl
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (3 * k)) % 7 := by simpa [hn3]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ k) % 7 := by simpa [Nat.pow_mul]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) % 7) ^ k % 7 := by
          have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
          simpa [this]
        _ = 1 ^ k % 7 := by simp
        _ = 1 % 7 := by simp
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    -- now conclude divisibility
    have : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 % 7 := by simpa [hpow]
      exact (Nat.ModEq_iff_dvd).mp (by
        change (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7]
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this)
    exact this

/-- Main theorem (b). -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  -- proof sketch:
  -- 1. Compute `2 ^ n % 7` using the period 3.
  -- 2. Show the possible residues are `1,2,4`, never `6` (which would correspond to `-1` mod 7).
  -- 3. Conclude that `2 ^ n + 1` cannot be divisible by 7.
  intro h
  have hmod : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
    -- from divisibility we get congruence `2^n ≡ -1 ≡ 6 [MOD 7]`
    have : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := h
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero).1 this
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (7 - 1) % 7 := by
      have := congrArg (fun x => x % 7) (by
        have := Nat.mod_add_mod (2 ^ n) 1 7
        sorry)
    sorry
  -- compute the actual remainder of `2 ^ n` modulo 7
  have hcycle : (2 ^ (n + 3)) % 7 = (2 ^ n) % 7 := pow_mod_seven_cycle n
  -- by examining `n % 3` we see the remainder can only be 1,2 or 4
  have hposs : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 := by
    -- write n = 3*q + r
    set q := n / 3 with hq
    set r := n % 3 with hr
    have hnr : n = 3 * q + r := by
      have := Nat.mod_add_div n 3
      simpa [hq, hr, Nat.mul_comm] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ r) % 7 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7
            = (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) % 7 := by simpa [hnr]
        _ = (2 ^ (3 * q) * 2 ^ r) % 7 := by simpa [Nat.pow_add]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ q * 2 ^ r) % 7 := by
            simpa [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) % 7 * (2 ^ r) % 7) % 7 := by
            simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod]
        _ = (1 * (2 ^ r) % 7) % 7 := by
            have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
            simpa [this]
        _ = (2 ^ r) % 7 := by simp
    have : r = 0 ∨ r = 1 ∨ r = 2 := by
      have : r < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases r <;> tauto
    rcases this with h0 | h1 | h2
    · left; simpa [h0] using this
    · right; left; simpa [h1] using this
    · right; right; simpa [h2] using this
  rcases hposs with h1 | h2 | h4
  · have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ≠ 6 := by simpa [h1]
    exact this hmod
  · have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ≠ 6 := by simpa [h2]
    exact this hmod
  · have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ≠ 6 := by simpa [h4]
    exact this hmod

  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: if 7 divides 2^n - 1, then 3 divides n
    intro h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₂ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := h
      have h₃ : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h₂
      have h₄ : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
        apply Nat.one_le_pow
        <;> linarith
      have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
        have h₆ : 2 ^ n = (2 ^ n - 1) + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h₄]
        rw [h₆]
        simp [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h₂]
        <;> norm_num
      exact h₅
    -- Analyze n mod 3
    have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
      have h₃ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃ | h₃)
      · exact h₃
      · -- Case n ≡ 1 (mod 3)
        have h₄ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by

          rcases h₅ with ⟨k, rfl⟩
          calc
            2 ^ (3 * k + 1) % 7 = (2 ^ (3 * k) * 2) % 7 := by rw [pow_add]
            _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ k) * 2) % 7 := by rw [pow_mul]
            _ = ((8 ^ k) * 2) % 7 := by norm_num
            _ = ((8 ^ k % 7) * (2 % 7)) % 7 := by rw [Nat.mul_mod]
            _ = ((8 % 7) ^ k % 7 * 2 % 7) % 7 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod]
            _ = ((1 ^ k) % 7 * 2 % 7) % 7 := by norm_num
            _ = (1 * 2) % 7 := by simp [Nat.one_pow]
            _ = 2 := by norm_num
